status: criteria specified before collection and before independent evaluation

pilotTarget.note: All 12 pilot accounts are searched in the Global pack, the new-install default; the diver's broad dive region is kept in private observationContext. Caribbean (2 publication species) and Tropical Pacific (0) would mostly measure coverage blocks.

assignment: SHA256('independent-v1:' + cohortID), first 8 hex digits modulo 5: zero holdout, otherwise development. All linked authors/encounters share a cohort. Any exposure promotes the entire cohort to development permanently; never rebalance after observing results.
rationale: Carry forward provisional development floors before seeing human cases, plus strict abstention/ambiguity/confidence contracts. These are screening criteria, not a calibrated accuracy or safety guarantee. Require 30 positives and 10 of each policy class before a pass/fail conclusion; smaller cohorts report descriptive metrics and insufficient sample. The 12-observation pilot checks collection and labelling only.
confidence: Finite relativeMatch strengths within [0,1], limited observations capped at 0.64, ambiguous cases capped at 0.64; not probabilities. Publish numerator/denominator and uncertainty caveats, never 0/0 as a pass.
coverage: Evaluate development pack and real publication subset separately. No approved target or unavailable selected pack is coverage-blocked, not a search failure or successful no-match. Unresolved labels are retained and excluded from quality denominators.
holdoutDisclosure: Only custodian sees wording, identities, case-level ranks/errors and raw logs. Development output receives aggregate numerators/denominators only. Do not enrich or tune from held-out cases; move the entire exposed cohort to development in a new dataset version and retain the old frozen baseline.
independence: Authorship attestation and separate identity verification are required, but software cannot prove human independence. No model-authored examples are accepted as independent data. No collection outreach is authorized by this protocol.
revisions: 2026-10-25, before any collection or freeze: pilot target changed from 4 Caribbean + 8 Tropical Pacific to 12 Global, and 'global' accepted as a region, because Release access offers 2 Caribbean and 0 Tropical Pacific species. Rank bounds, confidence caps, minimum rates, sample minimums and the assignment rule are unchanged. Latency and abstentions are reported descriptively, with no gate.

2026-10-28, before any collection or freeze: in-app collection added as an intake source (inAppCollection), approved by Bryce. Rank bounds, confidence caps, minimum rates, sample minimums, the pilot target and the assignment rule are unchanged.

inAppCollection.source: Dive ID 'Share my feedback' files: format diveid-diver-feedback, schemaVersion 1 (Data/Evaluation/DiverFeedbackExport.v1.md)
inAppCollection.contributorClaimedIdentity: The diver's tapped answer (claimedSpecies with claimedSpeciesID, none, or notSure) is kept in private provenance as contributorClaimedIdentity. It was given after seeing engine results, so it is engine-exposed: it is never copied to expectedSpeciesIDs, acceptableSpeciesIDs or label evidence, and it is withheld from the curator.
inAppCollection.labels: A curator who has not seen engine output, shownResults or contributorClaimedIdentity assigns expectedSpeciesIDs/acceptableSpeciesIDs from independent evidence: the diver's own photo or video, or an authoritative field guide or documented instructor assessment. Otherwise the label stays unresolved.
inAppCollection.retention: Qualifying records answered 'None of these' or 'Not sure' are imported like any other. No record is selected, rejected or reordered by engine success, rank or the diver's answer.
inAppCollection.nonQualifying: Records that fail a qualifying rule are not imported. Each is listed with its reason in the private intake log; descriptions are not copied there.
inAppCollection.deduplication: feedbackID; the same record in several shared files is imported once.
inAppCollection.attestation: The app does not ask the diver to attest that the words are their own and unprompted (author.attestsOwnUnpromptedWords). The custodian must obtain that attestation before freeze.
